test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The Emperor was considered as a __wicked __man.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Virtuous.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
 
• For example, hot and cold are antonyms.
 
 
 
• Now, let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Wicked" means someone morally bad or evil**.
 
 
• Example: He was a wicked and dishonest man.
 
 
 
• **"Virtuous" means having high moral standards and behaving in a righteous manner**.
 
 
• ​Example: The king was known for his virtuous deeds and fair rule.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "virtuous" is the antonym of the word "wicked."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In option 2 (Savage) means fierce, violent, or uncontrolled.
 
• In option 3 (Fierce) means showing aggression or intensity.
 
• In option 4 (Vile) means extremely unpleasant or morally reprehensible.
